quests.title: A Gift From Her

dialogue.t: That smells great! Did we make it in time for Columbina's mealtime again?
Huh. Are those kuuhenki... lining up? For soup that Columbina's serving?
Just a moment.
Wow, this is really good!
Refreshing, tasty fruit soup — Paimon's never had anything quite like it!
Another serving?
Make that two!

dialogue.sit: Are you learning to cook?

dialogue.t: Yes. I asked Ineffa for some basic recipes, and have made several attempts. The kuuhenki and animals have both responded quite positively.

dialogue.sit: Having any issues in the kitchen?

dialogue.t: Well... My sleeves are too wide. They brush against the pot if I'm not careful...

dialogue.sit: (So, it's not the cooking itself that's giving you trouble.)

dialogue.t: I struggle somewhat with making desserts, though.
You have to get the temperature and proportions just right...

dialogue.sit: (She must not have cooked much for herself in the past, then.)
(Besides, desserts and snacks are particularly hard to get right if you're working solo...)
Would you like me to help?

dialogue.t: Sure. Let's start with krumkake, shall we?

dialogue.sit: Some time later...

dialogue.t: Would you like to try one?

dialogue.sit: (Take a nibble.)
(Chow down.)
(Oh wow, that first bite probably soured my face into a prune...)
(But after you swallow some, the sweetness resurfaces... Maybe it gets better once you get used to it...)

dialogue.t: What do you think?

dialogue.sit: Passable...
But there's room for improvement...

dialogue.t: Did Paimon miss anything?

dialogue.sit: Try this real quick, would you?

dialogue.t: Gaaaah, it's so sour! Wh—What are you trying to do to Paimon!?
Haha...

dialogue.sit: The aftertaste is pretty good, though.

dialogue.t: It's all about the initial taste! Couldn't one of you have warned me to take a smaller bite!?
If you hadn't said anything, Paimon would've thought this was a prank! Watching people's faces pucker or something...
Okay. Let me try again.

dialogue.sit: More time passes...

dialogue.t: Here. Try this batch.

dialogue.sit: (Whoa...! This is way better!)
It's delicious!
You sure learn fast!

dialogue.t: Really? Paimon wants some too! ...Mmm! That's the stuff! Sooo tasty!
Good enough to be given as a gift?
Totally! Wait, did you learn how to cook and make krumkake because you wanted to make a present for someone?
Yes... For my friends.

dialogue.sit: That's a great idea.

dialogue.t: Do you still remember the first time you came here together? You had prepared some food for me.
Though the food couldn't do much to replenish the power I had lost, eating it did make me feel more relaxed.
I did not give it much thought then, but now I understand.
The time and effort put into carefully preparing food by hand is what gives it soul.
What I enjoyed was not simply the food itself, but the warmth and kindness in the hands that made it.
And the less those hands seek reciprocity, the greater the warmth and kindness required to match it in turn.
Awww, Paimon's gonna blush if you go on like that... To be honest, we were at least kinda hoping to get on your good side back there.

dialogue.sit: But things are different now.
If there's anything you'd like to eat, just say the word.

dialogue.t: Indeed. But now that I understand all this, I'd like to do a little more... It's a wonderful feeling.
Would you come with me to visit our friends?
Apart from the krumkake, I have also prepared a few other gifts. Ah, but they must be sent in secret.
Why "in secret," if you don't mind Paimon asking?
Well, you've always been the ones to "pleasantly surprise" me. I'd like to see how my friends will react when the tables are turned.
Phew. We were running all over! Finally done.
Their reactions were kind of surprising, though. Some didn't even realize they were gifts from you, Columbina...

dialogue.sit: Aino just got straight to snacking...

dialogue.t: It's fine. I expected as much. What's important is that they were happy to receive the gifts.
In that case, Lauma definitely knew the krumkakes and wreath on her desk came from you.
Paimon can understand her being hesitant about wearing the wreath, but seriously, she stared at the krumkakes for a good ten minutes and still couldn't bring herself to eat one...

dialogue.sit: I was getting worried that she might enshrine them...

dialogue.t: It seems Jahoda got quite the fright, though... Perhaps we shouldn't have slipped the gifts directly behind her...

dialogue.sit: She almost jumped out of her skin.

dialogue.t: Maybe she's just naturally more alert? Still, she seemed to calm down when Ashru came over to paw at the scratching post you sent.
As for our other friends who aren't in Nod-Krai, I'm counting on you to deliver their gifts.

dialogue.sit: I must say, you're quite good at preparing presents.

dialogue.t: Here.
Ooh! Is it finally our turn?
Huh? Candies? Paimon thought we'd get krumkakes like everyone else.
Well, you already had some of those while taste-testing. Some variety is nice, don't you think?

dialogue.sit: Yeah... They're really good, too.
Better than the Moon-Prayer Night candies, even.

dialogue.t: That's good to hear.
And there's one more gift. Here, for you.

dialogue.sit: This is... a wind glider?

dialogue.t: I've heard it said that the skies belong to the birds, and the land, to the beasts...
While the vast space between the two is reserved for adventurers wearing wing gliders.
With this by your side, may your path forward ever be lit as with moonlight.

dialogue.sit: It's perfect. Thank you.

dialogue.t: And thank you, for your companionship.

quests.description: Columbina seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall…
